AMENDMENT TEXT

Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment No. 1 (October 1, 2025)

Enforcement Rule of the Organization of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and Its Affiliated Institutions

[Main body omitted]

ADDENDA

Article 1 (Enforcement date)
This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation; provided, among the ministerial ordinances amended pursuant to Article 6 of the Addenda, the portions amending ministerial ordinances promulgated before this Rule enters into force but whose enforcement dates have not yet arrived shall each enter into force on the enforcement date of the relevant ministerial ordinance.

Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendments to other statutes or regulations)
(1) through (17) Omitted.

(18) The Enforcement Rule of the Act on the Management of Zoos and Aquariums is partially amended as follows:

In the main clause of Article 2 (1), and paragraphs (3) through (5) of that Article; Article 3; the portion of Article 4 preceding the subparagraphs; Article 13 (2) 7 and the latter sentence of paragraph (3) of that Article; Article 18 (1) 1 (a) and (c), and paragraphs (2) through (5) of that Article; Article 21 (4); the portion of Article 22 (1) preceding the subparagraphs and paragraphs (2), (4), and (5) of that Article; the proviso to Article 23 (2); and Article 24, "Minister of Environment" is replaced by "Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment" in each instance.

In the portion of Article 4 preceding the subparagraphs, "Ministry of Environment and" is replaced by "Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and". In the portion of Article 5 preceding the subparagraphs; the first sentence of Article 9 (1); Article 11; the portion of Article 14 preceding the subparagraphs; Article 15; the portion of Article 16 preceding the subparagraphs; the portion of Article 17 preceding the subparagraphs; the portion of Article 18 (1) preceding the subparagraphs; and the portion of Article 20 preceding the subparagraphs, "Ministry of Environment" is replaced by "Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment".

In Article 18 (1) 1 (c), "Rules on the Establishment and Supervision of Nonprofit Corporations under the Jurisdiction of the Ministry of Environment and the Korea Meteorological Administration" is replaced by "Rules on the Establishment and Supervision of Nonprofit Corporations under the Jurisdiction of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Korea Meteorological Administration".

In attached Forms 7 and 8, "Minister of Environment" is replaced by "Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment" in each instance.

(19) through (98) Omitted.

REASONS FOR ENACTMENT OR AMENDMENT

[Enactment]

Reasons for amendment and main provisions

The Government Organization Act is amended to reorganize the Ministry of Environment as the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment to take charge of environmental affairs, responses to climate change, and energy affairs, excluding matters concerning the export of nuclear power generation and resources such as oil, coal, gas, and minerals (Act No. 21065, promulgated and entering into force on October 1, 2025). In connection with that amendment, the Organization of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and Its Affiliated Institutions is enacted to prescribe the organization, scope of duties, personnel quotas, and other matters for the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and its affiliated institutions (Presidential Decree No. 35804, promulgated and entering into force on October 1, 2025). Accordingly, this Rule prescribes in detail matters such as the allocation of duties among subordinate organizational units and personnel quotas by grade in the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and its affiliated institutions.

<Provided by the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment>
